scan.title: Marks from sheet photo
scan.legend: Blue marks differ from your current data, amber outlines are worth checking. Tap a mark to change it.
scan.missing: Tasks from the sheet not found in this month: {count}. They were deleted or recreated after printing.

error.markers: Could not find the corner markers of the sheet. Photograph the whole sheet, straight and without glare.
error.qr: Could not read the sheet's QR code. Take a closer, sharper photo.
error.month: This sheet is for {month}. Open that month and try again.
error.noTasks: None of the tasks on this sheet exist in this month. Print the sheet again.

import.tooLarge: The file is too large (maximum 2 MB)
import.invalid: The file does not contain valid tracker data
import.newer: The file was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.

reason.offline: No connection. Changes are kept on this device and sync when the network is back.
reason.conflict: Data on this device and in the cloud differ. Sync is paused until you choose.
reason.permissionDenied: No access to cloud data. Try signing in again.
reason.unauthenticated: The session has expired. Sign in again.
reason.resourceExhausted: The cloud quota is exceeded. Retrying later.
reason.tooLarge: Too much data for the cloud (over 1 MB). Data is kept on this device, export it to a file.
reason.unknown: Could not reach the cloud. Data is kept on this device, retrying.

sync.failed: Cloud sync failed. Data is saved on this device.

archive.banner: Archive for {month}. You can still fix marks, stats will be recalculated.

grid.dayHint: Click to mark the day for all habits, right-click to skip
grid.legendSkip: Right-click or second click – skip, the day is not counted

list.skipped: skipped – the day is not counted
list.hint: Tap a circle: done → skip (the day is not counted) → empty. Tap a name for habit settings and the month’s marks.

empty.title: No habits yet
empty.text: Add your first one, like “Workout” or “Reading”. Mark it every day and see the percentage and grade at the end of the month.
empty.hotkey: Press N for a new habit

habit.title: Habit
habit.name: Name
habit.perDayHint: For example, 3 for sets or glasses of water. Up to {max}.
habit.subsWarning: Marks of removed subtasks will be deleted on save.
habit.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” and all its marks for {month}?
habit.subsRemoved: Extra subtasks deleted along with their marks

account.title: Account
account.localOnly: Your data is stored only in this browser. Sign in to sync it across devices.

showWeek.title: Week separators
showWeek.hint: Vertical lines between weeks in the table

calculationMode.title: Progress calculation
calculationMode.fullMonthHint: The percentage counts every day of the month, so it starts low.
calculationMode.passedDaysHint: The percentage counts only days up to and including today.

auth.unsaved: Changes on this device have not reached the cloud. If you sign out now, they will be removed from this device.

duplicate.title: Move habits to {month}?
duplicate.message: Habits ({count}) will be moved to {to} with empty marks.
duplicate.replaceWarning: The current list and marks of that month will be replaced.

welcome.title: A simple table to keep the rhythm
welcome.text: Add habits and mark them every day. At the end of the month you get a percentage for each, an overall average and a grade on a five-point scale.
welcome.skipHint: the day is not counted, e.g. a workout every other day
welcome.paper: You can print the table, mark it with a pencil on the fridge and transfer it here at the end of the month, by hand or from a photo of the sheet. Data is stored in the browser and works offline.

conflict.title: Data differs
conflict.message: This device and the cloud have different versions. Choose which one to keep, the other will be overwritten.
conflict.keptLocal: Cloud updated with data from this device
conflict.postponed: Version not chosen, sync is paused. You can choose later from the sync status.
conflict.invalid: Cloud data is damaged and cannot be loaded

update.message: A new version of the app is available

history.gone: This change can no longer be undone

importSheet.title: Import data
importSheet.truncated: Names longer than {max} characters will be shortened: {count}
importSheet.mergeHint: Months from the file are added to the current data.
importSheet.replaceHint: All current data is replaced with the file.
importSheet.settingsHint: Settings from the file are applied too.
importSheet.overlap: These months exist both here and in the file. Which version to keep?
importSheet.safety: A backup of the current data is saved first, and the import can be undone.

storage.quota: Browser storage is full, changes are not saved on this device. Export your data to a file.
storage.failed: Could not save data on this device. Export your data to a file.
